_readme: Site configuration for the RK3588 jammer backend (arm_port).
Every key is optional: defaults live in python/jammer_arm/config.py, which mirrors
matlab/backend/jammer_config.m. Only list what differs on this deployment.
Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored.
RF transparent transmission CANNOT be enabled from this file. Only the process
environment variable ZH_RF_TX_ENABLE=LAB_ONLY arms TX, and only in an authorized
shielded box or a sufficiently attenuated cabled setup.
power_db=0 means minimum TX gain, not 'off'.
_radio_notes: 192.168.10.2 is the X310 default address. On a 1 GbE link 20 MS/s is close to
the practical ceiling; if uhd_usrp_probe reports overruns, lower
sample_rate_hz/master_clock_rate or move the X310 to the 10 GbE SFP+ port.
tdm=true stops the RX stream while a TX burst is on air (shared TX/RX port).
